deviation: The draft removes Arcadia's right to terminate for convenience entirely (for both parties), so Arcadia is locked in for the full Term and can exit only for cause. This eliminates a core right and is worse than the fallback (90 days' notice after 12 months). The no-automatic-renewal term is favorable or neutral and is not a concern.
suggested_text: 3.3 Termination for Convenience. The Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time by giving 30 days' written notice to the Supplier, without penalty. Termination under this Section 3.3 is without prejudice to the Customer's right to terminate for cause in accordance with Article 10.
